notes.title: Patch Notes for Version 1.5.0
notes.content:
Here is the change log for patch 1.5.0

IMPORTANT NOTICE: Save files from previous version are not entirely compatible. We highly recommend you do not use them and instead start your current chapter over (Or first finish your current chapter before downloading this patch, and after you have  downloaded the patch start the next chapter from the main menu).

Features:
-The Infamous Math Box has been relocated to a new optional challenge room at the beginning of chapter 4, and as such is no longer mandatory. The reward for solving it is an in-game challenge trophy and a steam achievement.
-Chapter 4 now has one new puzzle where the Math Box used to be.
-Optimized textures to reduce VRAM usage. This should increase performance (Most noticeably on lower-end PCs)

Bug Fixes:
-Some small bug fixes

notes.title: Halloween sale, trading cards, and our thoughts
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

In this announcement we are going talk about the current state of the game as well as our future plans, and some miscellaneous topics.

Firstly, we want to thank all of you for the both the overall positive reception as well as all of the constructive criticism we have received. We are a two man indie team working on basically zero budget, so to see that so many people have enjoyed our game has made us very happy. 

[h2]Current State of the Game[/h2]
After the release of the game we have been hard at work improving/refining the game based on your feedback. We thought we would compile a list of some of the things we have added/changed since the release here:
-The ability to Save/Load the game
-Adjustments to the difficulty of some puzzles
-Slight adjustments to the locations of many objects, as well as drastically improving the effectiveness of Hint Vision (which spawns glowing lights around objects you have not found yet). These changes together should make the game more enjoyable to those players who do not enjoy searching the environment thoroughly for hidden puzzle items.
-Whole bunch of bug fixes
-Variety of options added to the settings menu, including some that might reduce the motion sickness experience by some people.
-Variety of other slight changes/additions (such as having name tags above the player characters in multiplayer)

The are still some changes we have not yet added, but which we are contemplating. Although we are now moving on to focus on our next project, we are still going to be updating/patching this game from time to time. If there are any features or changes you would wish us to implement, please let us know.

[h2]Steam Halloween sale[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41126926/cde329eb608bfb17b3a63ce6ff91734aecbc4e64.png[/img]
The game is on sale for the duration of the Steam Halloween sale. For that period, you can get it in -15% discount.


[h2]Trading cards[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41126926/7818d05865e70735434ccf1648653fac84a2b52a.png[/img]

Trading cards, badges, and other community icons are now available.


[h2]Future plans[/h2]
We are currently working to get our game localized to different languages. However, as many of the puzzles are dependent on exact wording/phasing of the text, the process of localizing is a bit more complicated than it would otherwise be and might take a while. We will keep you updated as we make progress on this topic.

Finally, let's talk briefly about our next project. While one of us has been busy updating/patching this game, the other one, who is mainly in charge of 3D art (modeling, texturing, environments etc), has already been busy working on our next game. As such, the project is already in quite a good state as far as the art is concerned. 
We are using all of the feedback we have received for this game to guide us into making the next one even better. We don't want to talk too much about the specifics yet, but we can tell you that our next game will be a similar cooperative escape-room-style puzzle game. We will let you know more once the time is right.

With best regards,
0 Deer Soft

notes.title: Patch Notes for Version 1.3.5
notes.content:

Features:
-Added "Movement Smoothing" option to settings. This setting has been on by default, but you can now disable it as well. Turning it off might reduce motion sickness experienced by some individuals.

notes.title: Patch Notes for Version 1.3.3
notes.content:
Here is the change log for patch 1.3.3

General:
-Slightly reduced the collision size of the player character. This should make cramped areas easier to navigate even when playing with multiple players.
-Reworked the appearance of the pause menu to be in-line with our other menus.
-Added "Join through Friend List" option to the multiplayer menu. It was always possible to join through the steam overlay friend list, this option just adds a dedicated button to opening it.

Bug Fixes:
-Fixed a bug where the ending music would sometimes play multiple times on top of itself.
-Added sounds to some objects that were missing them.

notes.title: Patch Notes for Version 1.3.2
notes.content:
Here is the change log for patch 1.3.2

Features:
-Added "Interaction Force" to settings menu. This option allows you to change how "heavy" interact-able objects (doors, drawers, etc) feel.

General:
-Adjusted how interaction force is handled for certain objects.

Bug fixes:
-Fixed various bugs caused by unstable network connections between the host and clients, such as players sometimes getting stuck in certain states (Getting stuck in zoom state, object getting stuck in players hand, etc).
-Various small fixes

notes.title: Patch Notes for Version 1.2
notes.content:
Here is the change log for patch 1.2

Puzzle Adjustments:
-Slightly shifted the locations of various notes and objects in order to make them a bit easier to find.
-Added additional hint to back of the note concerning the functioning of the safe in tutorial.

General:
-Reduced the force needed to open/move various objects, as well as adjusting the direction you need to move your mouse to open certain objects in order to make it feel more intuitive.

notes.title: Patch Notes for Version 1.1
notes.content:
Here is the change log for patch v1.1

Puzzle Adjustments:
-Made some slight adjustments to the mathematical device in chapter 4 to make it easier. It is still supposed to be very challenging but it should be more manageable now.
-Slightly adjusted the name puzzle device at the end of chapter 3 to make it clearer which letter is currently selected.

Features:
-Added options for invert mouse look to the settings menu. 
-Improved the effectiveness of hint vision by reducing its cooldown, increasing its duration, and making the particles more clearly move towards the hinted objects.

Bug fixes:
-Fixed a bug where the collectible display table had all of the collectibles visible for some people even though the player had not collected any of them.

notes.title: Full release of "First Class Escape: The Train of Thought"
notes.content:
It was a long journey to get to this point. Our game dev story started from 2015, when we started experimenting with lately released Unreal Engine 4. After over a six years of practicing game development as a hobby, we finally got the change to spent some time to make our first commercial game. We are more than proud to present you: "First Class Escape: The Train of Thought".

We sincerely hope you enjoy our game.
